title: 32 ## Arrests under the Important Heads of Crime : The break-up of the number of persons arrested during 1970 under the different heads of crime indicates that the highest number of arrests was in respect of ‘Riots’, which constituted 31.5% of the total arrests made during the year. However, there has been a decrease of 9.1% in arrests under this head during the year 1970 over 1969. The percentage increase in the number of persons arrested is very significant in respect of ‘Dacoity’ and ‘Robbery’, the increases being 23.9% and 28.6% respectively.
